$schemaNote: Row = one deposit-maturity bucket, one fiscal-year-end (end-March) snapshot. dateKind is always 'fy_snapshot' in this file (no exact-effective-date circulars were found that give a same-day rate for ALL banks before 1997; see milestones.json for exact-dated regulatory STEPS, as opposed to the rate LEVELS in this file).
coverage: FY1970-71 to FY1997-98 (end-March 1971 to end-March 1998). Earliest year available in any RBI source located in this research pass is 1970-71.
deregulationBoundary: Term deposit interest rates were fully deregulated (banks free to fix own rates with Board/ALCO approval) with effect from October 22, 1997 -- i.e., partway through FY1997-98. Rows for FY1995-96 through FY1997-98 already reflect actual bank rates during the transition (see 'appliesTo' and 'note' on each row) rather than a uniform RBI-mandated level.
gapsAndCaveats: No RBI source located (in this research pass) with deposit-rate LEVELS for 1964-1970. RBI began regulating banks' deposit-acceptance/rate practices around the 1960s (RBI History Vol. II, 1951-1967, chapter 'Regulating Banks and Deposit Institutions', https://www.rbi.org.in/scripts/rhvol-2.aspx, was identified but not opened in this pass) and, per secondary accounts, rates were earlier set by inter-bank agreement (Indian Banks' Association) before RBI prescription -- but no primary RBI table with actual rate levels for that period (pre-1970) was found. Do NOT show any deposit rate for years before 1970-71 in the tracker; mark as 'no data'.

This table's own header row (as extracted) reads only 'Year', not 'Year (as at end March)' as in the later Handbook of Statistics on Indian Economy editions (e.g. Table 74, Table 64, Table 62, Table 59) that continue this exact same series. The 'fiscal-year-end snapshot' dating convention is inferred from (a) the RBI Handbook of Statistics editions' explicit 'Year (as at end March)' header for the same continuing series, and (b) note '##' in this table stating figures 'refer to the deposit rates of 5 major public sector banks AS AT END-MARCH'. This has NOT been independently confirmed against the HMSI publication's own 'Notes on Tables' section (not located in this pass) -- flagged as a light inference, not an invented value.

The task brief's suggestion that RBI began prescribing deposit rates 'around 1964' was not independently corroborated in this pass; the only 1964-dated RBI action found was RBI being empowered (1 Feb 1964) to regulate deposit-acceptance activities of NON-BANKING institutions (RBI Act Chapter IIIB), which is a different matter from commercial-bank deposit-RATE prescription. Needs follow-up in RBI History Vol. II.

For FY1998-99 onward (post full deregulation), the same Handbook 'Structure of Interest Rates' table continues to report the actual rate range of '5 major banks' for these same 3 buckets plus a 'Savings' column, through FY2025-26 and a partial FY2026-27; these are NOT regulated/mandated rates and are therefore excluded from this file. Raw XLSX/PDF copies for FY2003-04 to FY2025-26 have been saved under raw/handbook/ and can be loaded separately for the tracker's post-deregulation display if desired.

This file's buckets are for DOMESTIC TERM DEPOSITS only. It does NOT include the savings deposit rate (see savings_rate_history.json) or lending rates (SBI advance rate / key lending rates), which appear in the same source table but are out of scope for this file.
